output.title: Behavioral fix for namespace-scoped deployments
output.content: This change fixes cert-manager behavior when deployed with the `--namespace` flag to limit scope to a single namespace. The environment runs cert-manager (evident from installed Certificate CRD and cert-manager.io/v1 manifests), but the environment evidence does not specify whether the deployment uses `--namespace` argument. Inspect your cert-manager Deployment spec to check if `--namespace` is set in container args; if it is, this fix may change cluster-scoped controller behavior.
